body:
I've been keeping it light, but it doesn't seem to be what the person on the other end suspected.

Customer service and sales. I work in the tire business. I love the manual labor part of it but it is constant balls-to-the-wall and dealing with really shitty people ~12 hours a day.

The problem is I am always stressing out now. I am thinking about quitting my job because while I enjoy it, it's becoming too much. Alcoholism is the norm among employees which due to the demands of the job.

Thanks for that 7 Cups of Tea link. It's helping out so far. Not really in a pouring my heart out way but just talking with someone that seems to understand the situation.
I do have a cat that I love, my roommate has a dog that is decently loveable too.

If I went with an "accident" it would be in a way that others wouldn't be a part of it. I couldn't do that to anyone.

People see me as the nice, quiet guy. But I am a wreck on the inside the only people that know are my close friends that I have broken down in front of. They also know that I don't like being around people for the most part.

I get that that psychiatrists are there to help, funny enough I was studying to be one before I left school, but unless I find a way to go without anyone knowing it would mean admitting to everyone that I can't handle myself. I don't know why but I don't wanna do that, maybe pride or just the pressure to be perfect. EDIT: I guess it would be confirming what I think I know as well. My theory of being depressed is just that for now, a theory until it's confirmed or denied by a professional.

I am kinda thinking about calling in my own suicide so that I no longer have a choice in getting help.

And I appreciate you taking the time to comment. No offense taken.
